title: Untitled Mistborn Film
overview: Based on Brandon Sanderson’s bestselling fantasy novel Mistborn: The Final Empire, the project follows Vin, a young street thief who joins the charismatic rebel Kelsier and his crew in an attempt to overthrow the seemingly immortal Lord Ruler. The adaptation is being developed at Apple TV as part of the company’s screen agreement with Sanderson for selected works from his interconnected Cosmere universe.
